fact: Matsapha became the first municipality to roll out the National Postcode and Addressing Project, giving each property a formal address, with street sign installation due within eight weeks, per ESCCOM and the Matsapha town planner.

The Municipal Council of Mbabane says it is leading implementation of the National Street Addressing and House Numbering Programme, a pilot launched by a partnership signed by the Ministers of Housing and Urban Development and of ICT.

fact: The Eswatini Standards Authority announced the launch of the Eswatini National Addressing Standards (SZNS ISO 19160 Parts 1 and 2), a single national framework for creating, assigning and maintaining addresses across urban and rural areas.
